description: Use when a Java/Spring change needs a planned multi-step task - deciding between the direct, light and full routes, opening, resuming or closing a ClaudeHut task, or checking which phase skill comes next. Re-anchor mid-session with /claudehut:claudehut-workflow.
should_trigger: how does this plugin's workflow work
start a new coding task in this Spring service
should this task be direct, light or full
re-anchor me on the claudehut process
which phase skill comes next for this task
do I need a spec for a one-line change
should_not_trigger: write the spec for this feature
what does the V12 Flyway migration change
list the reusable utils in this repo
